tables.name: gold_hourly_demand
tables.grain: one row per pickup_date and pickup_hour
tables.purpose: Hourly trip volume and revenue demand by time of day.

columns.name: pickup_date
columns.description: Calendar date for the pickup.

columns.name: pickup_hour
columns.description: Hour of the day in 24-hour format (0-23).

columns.name: trips
columns.description: Number of valid Silver trips in the slot.

columns.name: total_revenue
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for the slot.

columns.name: avg_fare
columns.description: Average fare_amount for trips in the slot.

columns.name: avg_distance_miles
columns.description: Average trip_distance in miles for trips in the slot.

columns.name: avg_duration_min
columns.description: Average trip_duration_min for trips in the slot.

example_questions_en: Which hour had the highest demand on 2024-01-15?
What was the total revenue for pickup hour 18 in January 2024?
How did average fare and trip length vary across morning and evening demand peaks?
example_questions_fr: Quelle heure a connu la demande la plus élevée le 2024-01-15 ?
Quel a été le revenu total pour l'heure de prise en charge 18 en janvier 2024 ?
Comment le tarif moyen et la durée du trajet ont-ils varié entre les pics du matin et du soir ?
caveats: Rejected rows are excluded because Gold is rebuilt from the valid Silver layer.
Revenue and averages ignore nulls, and only valid Silver rows are counted.
Cash tips are not recorded in total_amount per the source dictionary.

tables.name: gold_daily_demand
tables.purpose: Daily demand and revenue, with a weekday label aligned to the Silver pickup_dow encoding.

columns.name: pickup_date
columns.description: Calendar date for the pickup.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.description: Spark day-of-week encoding from Silver pickup_dow: 1 = Sunday, 7 = Saturday.

columns.name: day_name
columns.description: Human-readable weekday name mapped from the Silver pickup_dow value.

columns.name: trips
columns.description: Total valid trips on the date.

columns.name: total_revenue
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for the date.

columns.name: avg_fare
columns.description: Average fare_amount for the date.

columns.name: avg_distance_miles
columns.description: Average trip_distance in miles for the date.

example_questions_en: Which day in January had the most trips?
What was the weekday pattern for total revenue across the month?
How many trips occurred on Sundays compared with Thursdays?
example_questions_fr: Quel jour de janvier a enregistré le plus de courses ?
Quel a été le profil hebdomadaire du revenu total au cours du mois ?
Combien de courses ont eu lieu les dimanches par rapport aux jeudis ?
caveats: Rejected rows are excluded before aggregation.
day_of_week uses the same encoding as Silver pickup_dow and is not reinterpreted as Monday-first.
Flex Fare rows can be kept with null passenger counts and other missing fields when they otherwise pass Silver validation.

tables.name: gold_revenue_by_zone
tables.purpose: Trip counts and revenue grouped by pickup taxi zone and borough.

columns.name: pu_location_id
columns.description: Pickup taxi-zone ID from Silver.

columns.name: zone
columns.description: Pickup zone name from the TLC lookup, including Unknown.

columns.name: borough
columns.description: Pickup borough name from the TLC lookup, including Unknown.

columns.name: trips
columns.description: Total valid trips for the pickup zone.

columns.name: total_revenue
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for the pickup zone.

columns.name: avg_fare
columns.description: Average fare_amount for the pickup zone.

example_questions_en: Which zone generated the most revenue in January?
What is the average fare by borough?
Which taxi zones still appear as Unknown in the pickup lookup?
example_questions_fr: Quelle zone a généré le plus de revenus en janvier ?
Quel est le tarif moyen par arrondissement ?
Quelles zones de taxi apparaissent encore comme Inconnu dans la recherche de prise en charge ?
caveats: Unmatched pickup zones stay in Gold as Unknown to preserve the full valid trip volume.
This table aggregates by pickup zone only; drop-off zone is not used here.
Cash tips are not included because total_amount is the reported prepaid revenue total.

tables.name: gold_peak_hours
tables.grain: one row per day_of_week and pickup_hour
tables.purpose: Busiest weekday-hour slots ranked by average trips per operating day.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.description: Spark day-of-week value in the same encoding as Silver pickup_dow.

columns.name: day_name
columns.description: Human-readable day label associated with the numeric weekday.

columns.name: pickup_hour
columns.description: Hour of day for the slot.

columns.name: trips
columns.description: Trips in that weekday-hour slot across the month.

columns.name: avg_trips_per_day
columns.description: Trips in the slot divided by the distinct pickup dates that fall on that weekday.

columns.name: avg_fare
columns.description: Average fare_amount for the weekday-hour slot.

columns.name: peak_rank
columns.description: Dense rank of weekday-hour slots by avg_trips_per_day descending, with 1 being busiest.

example_questions_en: What were the busiest weekday-hour slots by average daily demand?
Which hour on Friday ranked highest after adjusting for the number of Fridays in the month?
How did weekday evening demand compare with weekday midday demand?
example_questions_fr: Quels étaient les créneaux les plus chargés par moyenne quotidienne de demande ?
Quel créneau du vendredi a obtenu le meilleur classement après ajustement au nombre de vendredis du mois ?
Comment la demande du soir en semaine se compare-t-elle à celle du milieu de journée ?
caveats: peak_rank is a dense rank based on average trips per day, not raw trip counts.
Slots are compared across all weekday-hour combinations; the denominator is the number of distinct pickup dates on that weekday in Silver.
Unlike raw counts, this measure normalizes for uneven weekday frequency within the month.

tables.name: gold_payment_mix
tables.purpose: Payment usage mix across valid Silver trips, including revenue share and total revenue.

columns.name: payment_type_id
columns.description: Payment type code from Silver payment_type.

columns.name: payment_type_name
columns.description: Human-readable label from the TLC dictionary.

columns.name: trips
columns.description: Total valid trips for a payment type.

columns.name: total_revenue
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for the payment type.

columns.name: share_of_trips_pct
columns.description: Trips share of the total valid trip volume for the month, expressed as a percentage.

example_questions_en: What share of trips were paid by credit card in January?
Which payment type had the highest total revenue?
How does the payment mix compare between cash and Flex Fare?
example_questions_fr: Quelle part des courses a été payée par carte bancaire en janvier ?
Quel mode de paiement a généré le revenu total le plus élevé ?
Comment le mix de paiement se compare-t-il entre cash et Flex Fare ?
caveats: Rejected rows are excluded from the mix, so the percentages represent valid Silver trips only.
Cash tips are not reported separately in the source; only reported total_amount is aggregated.
Flex Fare rows remain eligible even when passenger_count or other fields are null, as long as all Silver validation rules pass.

tables.name: gold_distance_duration_stats
tables.purpose: Distance-band summary for trip duration, fare and speed.

columns.name: distance_bucket
columns.description: Bucket label for the trip-distance range.

columns.name: bucket_order
columns.description: Sorting order for the bucket labels, from 1 to 6.

columns.name: trips
columns.description: Trips in the distance bucket.

columns.name: avg_duration_min
columns.description: Average trip_duration_min for trips in the bucket.

columns.name: avg_fare
columns.description: Average fare_amount for trips in the bucket.

columns.name: avg_speed_mph
columns.description: Average avg_speed_mph for trips in the bucket; null durations are excluded.

example_questions_en: Which distance band has the longest average trip duration?
How do average fare and speed change across the 0-1, 1-3, and 3-5 mile buckets?
What is the trip volume in the 10-20 mile band?
example_questions_fr: Quelle bande de distance a la durée moyenne de trajet la plus longue ?
Comment le tarif moyen et la vitesse évoluent-ils entre les intervalles 0-1, 1-3 et 3-5 miles ?
Quel est le volume de trajets dans la bande de distance 10-20 miles ?
caveats: Buckets are defined on trip_distance with lower-bound inclusion and upper-bound exclusion: 0-1, 1-3, 3-5, 5-10, 10-20, and 20+.
Exact boundaries such as 1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0 and 20.0 are assigned to the intended bucket per the defined rules.
Distance, duration, speed and shares are rounded only in the final projected Gold select.
